title: Koszul complexes vanish on the basic-open complement
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a nonnegative integer and f:Fin(r)→A. Let X=Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], U=⋃ᵢD(fᵢ), and choose derived categories of module sheaves on X and its over-site over U [def-pc-derived-category]. Let K be the image of the Koszul chain complex K_q=Λ^q_A(A^r), with contraction differential for f [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], extended to cochain degrees −q, sheafified termwise and localized to D(O_X). For every n∈ℤ, exact derived open restriction sends K[n] to a zero object.

source.place: Tag 09IR, lemma-orthogonal-koszul-complex, first displayed equality; More on Algebra, Tag 0663, lemma-homotopy-koszul

proof.text: Apply the unshifted restriction vanishing theorem to the sheafified Koszul complex on U.

The shift functor preserves zero objects, and the canonical commutation isomorphism identifies the restriction of the shifted object with the shift of its restriction. Transport IsZero across this isomorphism.

theorem isZero_restrict_shift_koszul
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hU : U = ⨆ i : Fin r, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (n : ℤ) :
    IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
            ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r f).extend
              ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)))⟦n⟧))
